ui.report_subtitle: Read-only Windows & Active Directory log triage mapped to MITRE ATT&CK
ui.clean_status: Clean baseline: zero suspicious Windows event patterns detected.

WET001.title: Brute-force or password spraying burst (Event 4625)
WET001.description: Repeated failed logon events (4625) within a short sliding window from a source IP or targeting multiple domain accounts.
WET001.remediation: Block or rate-limit offending source IPs at the firewall, enforce Smart Lockout, and review targeted accounts.

WET002.title: Brute-force burst followed by successful logon (4625 -> 4624)
WET002.description: A source IP or account suffered repeated authentication failures followed within 15 minutes by a successful logon.
WET002.remediation: Assume possible credential compromise: revoke active sessions/Kerberos TGTs, force password reset, and verify MFA.

WET003.title: Potential Kerberoasting activity (4769 RC4 encryption 0x17)
WET003.description: Service ticket requested with weak RC4-HMAC encryption (0x17) targeting a non-machine SPN, characteristic of offline password cracking.
WET003.remediation: Rotate affected service account credentials immediately to 25+ char passwords or gMSA, and enforce AES-only Kerberos.

WET004.title: Account lockout storm detected (Event 4740)
WET004.description: Multiple user lockouts indicate an active password spray or misconfigured cached credential service.
WET004.remediation: Identify Caller Computer Name in Event 4740 and isolate the source host or service.

WET005.title: Credential dumping / LSASS or NTDS access indicator
WET005.description: Process creation, script block, or handle access targeting LSASS memory or NTDS.dit database extraction.
WET005.remediation: Isolate the host immediately, enable Credential Guard / RunAsPPL, and rotate krbtgt and domain admin hashes twice.

WET006.title: Privileged security group membership modified (4728/4732/4756)
WET006.description: An account was added to Domain Admins, Enterprise Admins, Schema Admins, Administrators, Backup Operators, or Remote Desktop Users.
WET006.remediation: Verify change against approved ITSM tickets; remove unauthorized members and audit the actor account.

WET007.title: New user account created off-hours or elevated quickly (4720)
WET007.description: A newly provisioned local or AD user account appeared outside business hours or received privileged group rights soon after creation.
WET007.remediation: Disable unapproved accounts immediately and review creator logon session (Event 4624).

WET008.title: Suspicious Windows service installed (7045 / 4697)
WET008.description: A new service points to user-writable paths (Temp, AppData, Public, ProgramData), PsExec patterns, or encoded shell execution.
WET008.remediation: Stop and inspect the service binary path, collect its SHA-256 hash, and quarantine the originating host.

WET009.title: Suspicious scheduled task persistence (4698 / 4702 / 106)
WET009.description: Scheduled task created or updated using encoded PowerShell, LOLBins, or user-writable staging folders.
WET009.remediation: Export the task XML definition, delete unauthorized persistence triggers, and inspect child processes.

WET010.title: Windows Security or System event log cleared (1102 / 104)
WET010.description: Audit trail was explicitly wiped via wevtutil or Event Viewer, strongly associated with post-exploitation defense evasion.
WET010.remediation: Forward logs to an external SIEM before attackers clear local logs; investigate the subject account in Event 1102/104.

WET011.title: Shadow copy deletion or recovery sabotage (vssadmin / wmic / bcdedit)
WET011.description: Commands destroying Volume Shadow Copies or disabling Windows recovery modes, a classic pre-encryption ransomware step.
WET011.remediation: Disconnect host from SMB/AD networks immediately, preserve volatile memory, and validate immutable offline backups.

WET012.title: Microsoft Defender disabled, exclusion tampered, or malware alert
WET012.description: Real-time protection was turned off (5001), exclusions modified (5007), or Defender logged active malware detection (1116/1117).
WET012.remediation: Re-enable Tamper Protection via central MDM/GPO, remove unauthorized Defender exclusions, and isolate the endpoint.

WET013.title: Windows audit policy modified (Event 4719)
WET013.description: System audit policy subcategories were altered, potentially disabling Security logging blind spots.
WET013.remediation: Restore baseline GPO Advanced Audit Policy settings and investigate who executed auditpol.

WET014.title: Obfuscated or download-cradle PowerShell execution (4104 / 4688)
WET014.description: Script block or command line used -EncodedCommand, FromBase64String, Invoke-Expression, DownloadString, or AMSI bypass patterns.
WET014.remediation: Decode Base64 script content, block outbound C2 domains, and enforce Constrained Language Mode where feasible.

WET015.title: Suspicious RDP or explicit-credential lateral movement (4624/4648)
WET015.description: Interactive/RDP logon (Type 10/3) from external public/untrusted IP or explicit credential runas usage across hosts.
WET015.remediation: Verify VPN/bastion access, terminate active RDP session, and restrict RDP behind NLA + MFA + firewall allowlists.

WET016.title: Living-off-the-Land binary (LOLBin) abuse detected (4688)
WET016.description: Signed Windows utilities (certutil, mshta, bitsadmin, regsvr32, wmic) executed remote payload fetches or remote execution.
WET016.remediation: Quarantine downloaded staging files, block egress URLs, and apply AppLocker/WDAC rules on LOLBins.

WET017.title: Off-hours privileged logon detected (4672 / 4624)
WET017.description: Administrative logon occurred outside configured business hours window.
WET017.remediation: Confirm whether scheduled maintenance occurred; otherwise verify the administrator account activity.

WET018.title: Potential DCSync / AD replication abuse (Event 4662)
WET018.description: Directory Service replication GUID (DS-Replication-Get-Changes) invoked by an account that does not end with a Domain Controller '$' machine suffix.
WET018.remediation: Treat as Tier-0 domain compromise risk: revoke Replicating Directory Changes permissions immediately and rotate krbtgt twice.
